decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The application for the proposed extension of an existing crossover to 3.6m wide, as shown on drawing 338-SL-51 (Revision A), Received 8th September 2006, is recommended for approval as it is considered that the proposal would be acceptable as it would not be detrimental to the appearance and character of the existing street scene or the Chiswick House Conservation Area. The development is in accordance with the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003) and is compliant with supplementary guidelines.
description: Extension of existing vehicle crossover to 3.6m wide
